name: Revexa
description: Revexa is a UK research-peptide supplier based at 20 Wenlock Road, London N1 7GU, focused on peptide and longevity compounds for laboratory and investigational use. The catalogue spans 43 listings across metabolic research (Tirzepatide, Retatrutide, MOTS-C), repair and recovery (BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, KPV, the Klow blend), longevity (NAD+, Epitalon, Pinealon, SS-31), nootropics (Semax, Selank, Adamax, DSIP) and melanocortin research (PT-141, Melanotan II). Every compound is supplied as a lyophilised powder for reconstitution under sterile lab conditions, with product pages carrying research summaries, sequences and storage guidance. UK orders ship via tracked Royal Mail 24/48 with free delivery over £99, and orders placed before 2pm Monday to Friday are dispatched the same or next working day. Payment is accepted by major debit and credit card, bank transfer and cryptocurrency. All material is supplied strictly for laboratory research use only.
